findings.question: How much does the Tax Complete plan cost per month?
findings.claim: there is no major tax preparation software or service with a plan explicitly called 'Tax Complete.'
findings.fact: Tax Complete starts at $90 per month.
findings.note: Stripe explicitly offers a plan named Tax Complete.

findings.question: How much does the Tax Complete plan cost per month?
findings.claim: Tax software is almost universally sold as annual subscriptions for the tax year, not monthly subscriptions. There is no standard 'Tax Complete' monthly plan among major providers.
findings.fact: Tax Complete starts at $90 per month.
findings.note: The Stripe Tax Complete plan is billed at $90 per month.
